Prompt privacy

Metadata-only by default

Forsig logs spend, tokens, status, latency, model, and block reason. Prompts are not stored by default.

Provider keys

Your key stays protected

Provider keys are stored server-side and encrypted before storage. Your app uses Forsig virtual keys.

Rollback

One-line removal

Remove Forsig by changing your base URL back to your provider. No framework migration required.

Failure mode

Designed to fail visibly

If traffic is blocked or paused, Forsig returns clear status codes and human-readable reasons.

Seconds to install

Use the gateway directly, or add SDK headers when you need metadata.

JavaScript
npm install @forsig/sdk

import OpenAI from "openai";
import { forsigHeaders } from "@forsig/sdk";

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.FORSIG_API_KEY,
  baseURL: "https://gateway.forsig.com/v1",
});

await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Analyze this ticket" }],
}, {
  headers: forsigHeaders({ externalUserId: "user_123" }),
});
Python
pip install forsig

from openai import OpenAI
from forsig import forsig_headers

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["FORSIG_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://gateway.forsig.com/v1",
)

client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this ticket"}],
    extra_headers=forsig_headers(external_user_id="user_123"),
)

Private beta

Protect your AI agents before your next provider bill.

Join the private beta for early access, setup help, and free beta usage.

Does Forsig store prompts?

Not by default. The MVP stores metadata, token counts, cost, prompt hashes, latency, and policy outcomes.

Does Forsig replace my agent framework?

No. Forsig registers and controls external agents. Your agent remains in your app.

Do I have to use an SDK?

No. Any OpenAI-compatible client can use Forsig by changing the base URL and API key.

What happens when an agent hits its budget?

Forsig blocks the request before the provider call and returns a clear budget error with a reason.

Which providers are supported first?

The first gateway path is OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Anthropic and others come after the MVP.

Can I remove Forsig later?

Yes. Change your base URL and API key back to your provider. Your agent code does not need a rewrite.

Is Forsig production-ready?

Forsig is entering private beta. Early users should expect setup help and fast iteration before broad production use.
